visual_audit_fixes_round2.source: second-round re-audit of concept-06 (3 confirmed, pixel-verified findings)
visual_audit_fixes_round2.method: Two independent measurements per surface. (a) Analytic: every text-bearing element inside #pmStage plus the status bar probed over CDP for its computed color composited over its composited ancestor ground, WCAG relative-luminance ratio, across 10 theme/width/route scenes. (b) Pixel: settled PNGs (1400ms, past the staggered .c06-rise entrance) decoded with a pure-python PNG reader and sampled per text rect. Analytic is the reported figure; pixel sampling of 10-11px glyphs under the sandbox's blocked webfonts understates dark-on-light text by ~2 points of ratio through antialiasing and is used only as a direction check.

fixes.finding: R2-1 (minor, clipping): the first overflow fix replaced the 760px hard clip with per-item ellipsis that collapsed nav labels to one or two characters ('Da...', 'P...', 'W...')

fixes.verified: friendly-dark-760-home and basic-dark-760-home regenerated and inspected: the strip renders exactly one whole tab — the active 'Settings' pill — with no ellipsis, no stub, and no mid-word clip. Measured 10.46:1 (friendly-dark) and 11.76:1 (basic-dark) on the active tab label. States control is the quiet icon dot, clear of content.

The stylesheet has no hardcoded greys, no opacity dimming of text, and no color-mix on any text colour (its two color-mix tokens, --c06-ink-soft / --c06-ink-faint, are hover and rule washes derived from --text-primary). The calibrated tokens therefore land unmodified on every concept-06 surface.
